title: Contents Packout & Storage Return Trip Schedule by Policy State
content:
The company's Contents Packout & Storage trip schedule for the move-back truck line of a return follows the policy state on the job's linked claim file: **a policy state of FL carries the Florida trip factor, a policy state of LA carries the Louisiana trip factor, and any other policy state, or a job with no linked claim file, carries a trip factor of one.**

| Policy state on the linked Insurance Claim Services claim file | Trip factor |
|---|---|
| FL | 1.1 |
| LA | 1.05 |
| any other state, or no linked claim file | 1 |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A rate per load of 200.00 before the factor is 220.00 under a Florida claim file and 210.00 under a Louisiana claim file.
